summary.en-US: Mass block X (Twitter) accounts from followers, likes, reposts, replies, searches or imported lists. Review before you block, undo anytime. Paced to stay under X's limits, private, and multilingual.

description.en-US:
X Blocker is a mass block tool for X (Twitter): block many accounts at once, safely, and undo it if you change your mind.

**How it works**

- Open a followers, following, likes, reposts, replies, search, list or community page on x.com. The X Blocker panel at the bottom works with that list's accounts only.
- Press Review, untick anyone you want to keep, and press Block. Accounts are blocked one by one in the background while you keep browsing. Prefer no review? Turn it off in Settings and the button becomes Block, which queues the whole list at once.
- Posts and accounts also get a Block button. It asks first and blocks right away, like X does, or, if you prefer, adds the account to the paced queue with one click. You can show the buttons everywhere, only on lists, or turn them off.
- Long lists can be done in parts: review, block, scroll and review again, or let Load all scroll to the end for you.
- Every list you block is a batch. Undo a whole batch from the dashboard, or unblock single accounts.
- Import @handles, profile links or IDs (text or CSV). Export your blocked list or queue as a CSV to keep or share. IDs keep working when people change their handle.
- Available in English, فارسی (Persian), العربية (Arabic), Deutsch, Español, Français and Türkçe, with full right-to-left layouts for Persian and Arabic. It follows your browser's language, or pick one in Settings.

**Safety**

- Hourly and daily limits (150 and 1,000 by default) and human-like pacing keep you under X's limits.
- If X slows you down, the queue waits and then resumes by itself.
- Never blocks you, and by default skips people you follow and people who follow you. You can also skip verified accounts and keep a Never block list.
- Look-alike display names and @mentions can't redirect a block to the wrong account.

**Privacy**

- Everything stays in your browser. There is no server, no analytics, no account and no tracking.
- Messages, notifications and settings pages are never read.
- Only the accounts you queue and block are saved, on your device. Nothing is uploaded or shared.
- Delete all data erases everything in one click.

Open source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/bitcooker/x-blocker

X Blocker is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp.

version.approval_notes:
Thank you for reviewing.

SOURCE: The submitted files are the source. There is no minification, bundling or transpiling. scripts/build.mjs only copies extension/ to dist/firefox (and leaves out *.md files). Repository: https://github.com/bitcooker/x-blocker

REMOTE CODE: The extension never executes remote code in its own (privileged) context. To call X's web API exactly like x.com does, content/main-world.js runs in x.com's page (MAIN world) and dynamically imports x.com's own first-party request-signing module, which is the same file x.com's client loads. X requires that module to produce the x-client-transaction-id header. The URL is discovered from scripts the page already loaded and is validated against ^https://abs.twimg.com/x-web/.../sign.*.js$ before import (see signer() in content/main-world.js). The module runs with the page's own privileges only. No other remote code or resource is loaded; there is no eval, new Function or innerHTML.

PERMISSIONS: storage and unlimitedStorage: the queue, batches and block history (can reach thousands of accounts). alarms: resumes the block queue after a rate limit, even when the x.com tab's timers are throttled. webRequest, webRequestBlocking, webRequestFilterResponse: passively read X's GraphQL responses (filterResponseData) to list the accounts on the page; nothing is modified or blocked. Host access: https://x.com/* and https://api.x.com/* only. PRIVATE WINDOWS: Firefox keeps the extension off in private windows unless the user turns it on. If they do, only accounts the user deliberately queues or blocks are saved. The cache of accounts X showed is in storage.session (memory), and no browsing history is kept.

NETWORK / DATA: Requests go only to x.com / api.x.com, using the user's own session. Private operations (DMs, chat, notifications, account, settings, payments) are skipped (PRIVATE_OPS in background.js). Nothing is transmitted to any other server. All data is stored in storage.local; the temporary cache of accounts X showed is in storage.session. data_collection_permissions: none.

THIRD-PARTY: extension/fonts/Vazirmatn-NL.woff2 is the unmodified Vazirmatn v33.003 "Non-Latin" variable font from the official release https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/releases/tag/v33.003 (file misc/Non-Latin/fonts/webfonts/Vazirmatn-NL[wght].woff2, SHA-256 cdef5578ea583313cbea060a14aa107955a99717a861971b860cb564dfe1bbf5), SIL Open Font License (extension/fonts/Vazirmatn-OFL.txt). It is used only for Persian and Arabic text and is exposed to x.com pages through web_accessible_resources for the on-page panel. There are no other third-party libraries.

TESTING: Requires an X account. A dedicated test account is provided in the credentials field of this submission. Log in to x.com and open https://x.com/<any user>/followers. Block buttons appear next to Follow, and a panel at the bottom offers Review. The dashboard is the options page (Settings has the language, review and Block button choices).
